# FuseScope Collector

Monitor the FuseScope Collector itself: refused and dropped data, export queues, ClickHouse inserts and RUM refusals

|---|---|
| Id | `builtin-fusescope_collector` |
| Version | 1.0.0 |
| FuseScope | `>=0.164.0` |

## Metrics

| Name | Type | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `otelcol_process_uptime` | Sum | s | Seconds since the collector started; its absence means no telemetry. |
| `otelcol_process_memory_rss` | Gauge | bytes | Resident memory of the collector process. |
| `otelcol_receiver_accepted_spans` | Sum | number | Spans a receiver accepted. |
| `otelcol_receiver_accepted_log_records` | Sum | number | Log records a receiver accepted. |
| `otelcol_receiver_accepted_metric_points` | Sum | number | Metric points a receiver accepted. |
| `otelcol_receiver_refused_spans` | Sum | number | Spans a receiver refused. |
| `otelcol_receiver_refused_log_records` | Sum | number | Log records a receiver refused. |
| `otelcol_receiver_refused_metric_points` | Sum | number | Metric points a receiver refused. |
| `otelcol_receiver_failed_spans` | Sum | number | Spans a receiver failed to take in. |
| `otelcol_receiver_failed_log_records` | Sum | number | Log records a receiver failed to take in. |
| `otelcol_receiver_failed_metric_points` | Sum | number | Metric points a receiver failed to take in. |
| `otelcol_exporter_sent_spans` | Sum | number | Spans an exporter sent. |
| `otelcol_exporter_sent_log_records` | Sum | number | Log records an exporter sent. |
| `otelcol_exporter_sent_metric_points` | Sum | number | Metric points an exporter sent. |
| `otelcol_exporter_send_failed_spans` | Sum | number | Spans an exporter failed to send, so dropped. |
| `otelcol_exporter_send_failed_log_records` | Sum | number | Log records an exporter failed to send, so dropped. |
| `otelcol_exporter_send_failed_metric_points` | Sum | number | Metric points an exporter failed to send, so dropped. |
| `otelcol_exporter_enqueue_failed_spans` | Sum | number | Spans that did not fit an exporter's queue, so dropped. |
| `otelcol_exporter_enqueue_failed_log_records` | Sum | number | Log records that did not fit an exporter's queue, so dropped. |
| `otelcol_exporter_enqueue_failed_metric_points` | Sum | number | Metric points that did not fit an exporter's queue, so dropped. |
| `otelcol_exporter_queue_size` | Gauge | number | Items in an exporter's queue. |
| `otelcol_exporter_queue_capacity` | Gauge | number | Capacity of an exporter's queue. |
| `otelcol_exporter_fusescope_clickhouse_insert_errors` | Sum | number | Failed INSERT attempts into ClickHouse, by table and outcome. |
| `otelcol_exporter_fusescope_clickhouse_insert_duration` | Histogram | s | Duration of each INSERT attempt into ClickHouse, by table and outcome. |
| `otelcol_receiver_rum_requests_refused` | Sum | number | RUM requests refused, by reason. |
